mapping_rule: Ordinal image/caption numbering was checked against each canonical stanza and the visible reference. Each reference remains visual guidance only; semantic mismatches and montage content are recorded per row.

images.semantic_match: 001.jpg and caption #1 show Brahma seated on the navel lotus, turning outward; they support the ordinal match. The reference's polished cosmic treatment and hand details are not instructions.
002.jpg and caption #2 show Brahma on a lotus over causal waves with a visible stem; the unshown source is explicit in the canonical stanza and will remain absent.

003.jpg is a two-part lotus/Brahma montage and does not clearly depict the descent through a hollow stem. It is mapped ordinally but supplies only lotus and Brahma iconographic cues; the new scene follows the canonical stanza and caption #3.
004.jpg juxtaposes a searching landscape and a meditating Brahma. It supports the lotus/meditation motifs but its split composition and second depiction are not to be repeated.

005.jpg shows Brahma meditating with a small reclining Narayana and additional tiny worshippers. Ordinal caption #5 matches the vision, but the extra figures are not in the stanza and will be omitted.

006.jpg depicts Narayana reclining with Lakshmi and a small lotus-born figure; the supplied caption #6 instead names Bhattathiri worshipping the jeweled form. This is a content mismatch. Keep the canonical/caption subject and omit Lakshmi and the unrelated small Brahma.
007.jpg and caption #7 show the two principal figures in a praise/teaching encounter; the paper-like marks in the reference are not to be reproduced.
008.jpg is a two-panel collage of deity and Brahma imagery. Its subject cues match caption #8, but the new scene is one continuous moment with one Brahma and one Lord.

009.jpg is another montage, including lotus-born Brahma and cosmic imagery; it supports the lotus/tapas cues but does not clearly show the stanza's wind and water action. The new plan follows the caption and stanza, without copying collage panels.

010.jpg is a complex cosmic collage with repeated Brahma imagery. Caption #10 matches creation and Bhattathiri's plea, but the duplicate figures and planetary montage are excluded; the plan uses one figure of each named character and symbolic world-bands.
